        _mb.Text = "Mode: Head"
        _mb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 30, 30)
    else
        _mode = _K[13]
        _mb.Text = "Mode: Chest"
        _mb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    end
end)

local function _addH(char)
    if _hl then _hl:Destroy() end
    if char then
        _hl = Instance.new(_K[17])
        _hl.Name = "HL_" .. tostring(math.random(100, 999))
        _hl.Adornee = char
        _hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
        _hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        _hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        _hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
        _hl.AlwaysOnTop = true -- 
        _hl.Parent = char
    end
end

local function _remH()
    if _hl then _hl:Destroy(); _hl = nil end
end

local function _getPart(char)
    if _mode == _K[14] then
        return char:FindFirstChild(_K[14]) or char:FindFirstChild(_K[15])
    else
        return char:FindFirstChild(_K[15]) or char:FindFirstChild(_K[14])
    end
end

-- 
local function _getTarg()
    local best = nil
    local minAngle = math.huge
    local camLook = _cam.CFrame.LookVector

    for _, v in pairs(_p:GetPlayers()) do
        if v ~= _lp and v.Character then
            local c = v.Character
            local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass(_K[16])
            local pt = _getPart(c)
            if h and pt and h.Health > 0 then
                local dirToTarget = (pt.Position - _cam.CFrame.Position).Unit
                local dist = (pt.Position - _cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude
                
                if dist <= _cfg.Dist then
                    -- 
                    local angle = math.acos(camLook:Dot(dirToTarget))
                    if angle < minAngle then
                        minAngle = angle
                        best = c
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function _toggle()
    _locked = not _locked
    if _locked then
        _target = _getTarg()
        if _target then
            _lbs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
            _addH(_target)
        else
            _locked = false
        end
    else
        _target = nil
        _remH()
        _lbs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    end
end

_lb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(_toggle)

--  Anti-Cheat
_r.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _locked then
        if not _target or not _target.Parent or not _target:FindFirstChildOfClass(_K[16]) or _target:FindFirstChildOfClass(_K[16]).Health <= 0 then
            _locked = false
            _target = nil
            _remH()
            _lbs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            return
        end
        local pt = _getPart(_target)
        if pt then
            local offset = Vector3.new(
                (math.random(-1, 1) * 0.001),
                (math.random(-1, 1) * 0.001),
                (math.random(-1, 1) * 0.001)
            )
            _cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(_cam.CFrame.Position, pt.Position + offset)
        end
    end
end)

scripts.script:
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local screenGUI = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
screenGUI.Parent = player.PlayerGui
screenGUI.ResetOnSpawn = false

local mindistance = player.CameraMinZoomDistance
	
local maxdistance = player.CameraMaxZoomDistance

local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Parent = screenGUI
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 100)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.033, 0, 0.757, 0)


local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.Parent = MainFrame
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
button.Parent = MainFrame
button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
button.Position = UDim2.new(0.028, 0, 0.07, 0)
button.Text = "Cam"
button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.27451, 0.27451, 0.27451)
button.TextScaled = true

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.Parent = button
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local textbox = Instance.new("TextBox")
textbox.Parent = MainFrame
textbox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
textbox.Position = UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 0.47, 0)
textbox.Text = "camera id here..."
textbox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
textbox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.27451, 0.27451, 0.27451)
textbox.TextScaled = true


local keyToCam = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.KeypadOne] = 1,
	[Enum.KeyCode.KeypadTwo] = 2,
	[Enum.KeyCode.KeypadThree] = 3,
	[Enum.KeyCode.KeypadFour] = 4,
	[Enum.KeyCode.KeypadFive] = 5,
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = 0,
	[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2] = 6,
}

local currentCam = ""
local function placeCamera()
	local text ,wrongtext = textbox.Text:gsub("%D","")
	local cameraId = tonumber(text)
	if cameraId > 5 then 
		print("id is too high, you dont have that many buttons idiot.")
	else

		local Camera = Instance.new("Part")
		if workspace:FindFirstChild("Camera" .. cameraId) then
			Camera:Destroy()
			local camera2 = workspace:FindFirstChild("Camera" .. cameraId)
			camera2.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
		else
			Camera.Name = "Camera" .. cameraId
			Camera.Parent = workspace
			Camera.Anchored = true
			Camera.CanCollide = false
			Camera.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
			Camera.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0)
		end
	end
end
local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
highlight.Parent = player.Character
highlight.FillTransparency = 1
highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
highlight.Enabled = false


local function changeCamera(cameraNum)
	print(currentCam == ("Camera" .. cameraNum))
	if currentCam == ("Camera" .. cameraNum) then
		local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
		
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid		
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
		
		player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 5
		player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 5
		task.wait(0.1)
		player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = maxdistance
		player.CameraMinZoomDistance = mindistance
		
		currentCam = ""
		highlight.Enabled = false

	else

		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = workspace:FindFirstChild("Camera" .. cameraNum)
		player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
		
		currentCam = "Camera" .. cameraNum
		keyToCam[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1] = cameraNum
		
		UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		highlight.Enabled = true
		print(cameraNum)
		
	end
end

for i = 1, 5 do
	local clone = button:Clone()
	clone.Parent = MainFrame
	clone.Position = UDim2.new(0.028 + ((i - 1) * 0.2), 0, 0.07, 0)
	clone.Text = "Cam " .. i
	clone.Name = "button" .. i
	clone.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		changeCamera(tonumber(clone.Name:gsub("%a", "")))
	end)
end
button:Destroy()

local button6 = Instance.new("TextButton")
button6.Parent = MainFrame
button6.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 30)
button6.Position = UDim2.new(0.028, 0, 0.47, 0)
button6.Text = "place cam"
button6.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
button6.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.27451, 0.27451, 0.27451)
button6.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	placeCamera()
end)

local UICorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner.Parent = button6
UICorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)



local flipandflop = true
UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	-- Ignore inputs if the player is typing in your text box
	if gameProcessed then return end 

	-- Check if the pressed key matches one of our camera numbers
	local cameraNum = keyToCam[input.KeyCode]
	if cameraNum then
		changeCamera(cameraNum)
	end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.KeypadSix or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 and currentCam ~= "" then
		if flipandflop then
			workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 10
			UIS.MouseDeltaSensitivity = 0.1428571428571429
			flipandflop = false
		else
			workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = 70
			UIS.MouseDeltaSensitivity = 1
			flipandflop = true
		end
	end
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and currentCam ~= "" then
		changeCamera(keyToCam[Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1])
	end
end)

            local isSheriff = plr.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") or char:FindFirstChild("Gun")

            if ESP then
               if isMurderer then
                  h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255,0,0)

               elseif isSheriff then
                  h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,255) -- 🔵 FIXED BLUE

               else
                  h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromHSV((tick()%5)/5,1,1)
               end
            end

            -- DANGER SYSTEM
            if Danger and LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
               local dist = (LP.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - char.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

               if isMurderer and dist < 30 then
                  DangerLabel:Set("⚠️ GO FAR GO FAR MURDERER ("..plr.Name..")")
               else
                  DangerLabel:Set("✅ Safe")
               end
            end
         end
      end

      -- GUN ESP
      if ShowGun then
         for _,obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("Tool") and obj.Name == "Gun" then
               if not obj:FindFirstChild("GunHighlight") then
                  local g = Instance.new("Highlight")
                  g.Name = "GunHighlight"
                  g.FillTransparency = 1
                  g.OutlineTransparency = 0
                  g.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0)
                  g.Parent = obj
               end
            end
         end
      end

      task.wait(0.5)
   end
end)
